title: Little Whale · Live room
empty: Type as the host or a viewer, or start the microphone.
offline: Cannot connect to the local service. Run the desktop launcher.
token: Cohost access token (not a model key)
configNote: The local service controls the live persona, model, and voice. AIRI appearance settings apply. Native chat provider settings do not control this room.
decisionError: The request or response parsing failed. Please say that again.
decisionTimeout: The model request timed out. Please say that again.
input_recognizing: Recognizing speech. Continuing keeps the previous sentence.
input_empty: No text recognized. Please say another sentence.
input_short: That sound was too short. Please say a full sentence.
inputIssue_recognition: Recognition failed. Check the network. The microphone remains active.
inputIssue_connection: Capture feedback did not reach the local service. Check the local connection.
inputIssue_detection: Speech detection failed. Stop and restart the microphone.
inputIssue_device: The microphone disconnected. Check the system device, then restart capture.
inputIssue_backlog: Recognition is backed up. Pause, then restart the microphone.
inputQuiet: Recent volume is low. If you are speaking, check the system microphone and input level.
failed: Reply failed. Check the network and local settings.
tip: Ctrl + Enter to send · Viewer comments are simulated
voiceTip: Use headphones. Collapsing the panel keeps the microphone active.
biliMissing: Complete local setup. You can use blivechat without your own developer application.
biliLocalRelay: Source: local blivechat. Connected confirms the relay channel; incoming chat confirms room delivery.
biliError_configuration: Local connection settings are incomplete. Open chat setup.
biliError_credentials: Authentication was rejected. Check the anchor code or developer credentials.
biliError_platform: Chat service rejected the request. Check access, the anchor code or connection limits.
biliError_network: Cannot reach chat service. In local mode, make sure blivechat is running.
biliError_rate_limit: Bilibili rate limit reached. Try again later.
biliError_protocol: Unsupported data received. The connection has stopped.
biliError_timeout: Bilibili connection or heartbeat timed out.
